name: Elizabeth DeMeritt House
use: Formerly Home Economics practice house; most recently Upward Bound offices (leased by UNH)
statusNote: Demolished about 2019; leased, not UNH-owned, by 2018

renovations.what: Moved from the corner of Ballard St and Garrison Ave to Garrison Ave

facts.text: Built in 1930 as the Practice House, where Home Economics students lived for seven weeks in a home-management course.
Named for Elizabeth Pickering DeMeritt, Ballard Hall matron and Dean of Women (1919–1931).
In 2018 the student paper reported that UNH did not own the house but had leased it, and that occupants were moving out.
The UNH archives record it as demolished around 2019.
